answer_1.quote: In this work , we aim to study how to improve manual prompts for classification tasks under zero-shot settings using moderately sized masked language models. Specifically, we use the binary sentence-level sentiment classification tasks as the testbed.

answer_2.quote: We use Accuracy (Acc.) and macro F1 score (F1) for all the datasets to evaluate the performance of ZS-SC and compare it with baselines under different settings.
